'''Route 6903''' was a transit route in [[Cityblock Kesk-319]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]]<ref name="Raid" /> in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].{{FarOrbitDate}} The [[Pathline Tapcafe]], a [[Tapcafe/Legends|tapcafe]], was located at the intersection of Route 6903 and [[Citypath 515]], another road. Like all streets in [[Kesk Cityblock]], Route 6903 was wide and active, but was rarely used by pedestrians and private vehicles.<ref name="Raid" />

==Behind the scenes==
Route 6903 was first mentioned in ''[[Raid on Brentaal]]'', an adventure scenario in [[1998]]'s ''[[The Far Orbit Project]]'', by [[Timothy S. O'Brien]]. The book was a supplement to [[West End Games]]'s ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' and had the same theme of the previous publication ''[[Pirates & Privateers]]'', as it followed the privateering [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] ''[[Far Orbit]]'' in its adventures.
